row: Calhoun Community College is Alabama's largest 2-year college with more than 12-thousand students.  Calhoun is located in the center of North Alabama serving Huntsville-Decatur-Athens and surrounding communities.  Calhoun Educational Television (CETV) operates from the institutions main campus in Decatur.  Calhoun is about an hour North of Birmingham, an hour South of Nashville, Atlanta is three hours to the East and Memphis is three hours to the West.  Enjoy all of our videos...and stay tuned many more are on the way!
